scoring_justification: Checker recomputes nucleation work ratios and reduction from the wetting angles reported by the agent, using the paper's formula, and compares them with the agent's own reported values. No hidden paper targets are used.

outputs.description: Computed nucleation work ratios and reduction percentage; checker recomputes from the wetting angles and compares within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The scoring is based solely on internal consistency between the angles and the derived quantities. No externally provided target values are used.

steps.description: Recompute nucleation work ratios and reduction from agent's wetting angles and compare to agent's reported values
